podcast.body: One of three number one singles for Usher in 2004, which, along with "Yeah!" and "Burn," saw him replace himself at number one twice, signifying an intensely imperial year. "He replaced himself at number one twice between the singles Yeah, Burn and Confessions Part 2."

podcast.body: This title track from Usher's diamond-certified "Confessions" album was the winner of the 2004 Billboard Song of the Summer. It is noted for its "fiery sound and soap opera worthy lyrics." "He took song of summer again with the title track Confessions Part 2."
